LanguageData.FB_Stingmite.label: stingmite
LanguageData.FB_Stingmite.description: A disposable fleshbeast that leaps at hostile targets, stuns them and plants a flesh parasite in the struck body part. The parasite spreads, tears the part off when it matures and crawls out as a fingerspike. It bursts harmlessly against mechanoids.
